growth_signal.value: Named in the VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026, which requires at least 5M euro yearly revenue and 40% growth over three years.

entry.idea: Researchers and AI teams struggle to find real, trustworthy people for studies and feedback, so Prolific runs a site where verified people get paid to take part.
entry.lesson: A two-sided marketplace gets stronger when you guarantee quality on the supply side, here verified people.
entry.name: Prolific

growth.reason: Its place on a list that requires 5M euro revenue and 40% growth is real but indirect evidence.

market.reason: Every research group and AI lab needs human data, so the market is large and worldwide.

tech.reason: Solid platform with a verified participant pool, but a good team could copy the software.

entry.twist: It offers people from many backgrounds and countries, so AI models can be tested against what a wide mix of real people prefer.
entry.who_pays: Researchers, universities and AI companies pay to run studies; participants are paid out of that money.
entry.why_now: AI builders need large amounts of human feedback to train and check their models.
